firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently drank a cup of tea is the starting player and takes the starting player marker.
clarifications: Worker placement begins with the starting player and continues clockwise. During the game, taking the last Stockyard action space gives that player the starting player marker for subsequent placement rounds.
